BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+SANNEH FOUNDATION; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Sanneh Foundation, a nonprofit organization, to fund out-of-school and summer programs focused on mentoring and behavioral, social, and emotional learning interventions and enrichment activities directed toward low-income students of color. bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to the Sanneh Foundation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SANNEH FOUNDATION; APPROPRIATION.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Sanneh Foundation, a nonprofit organization, to fund out-of-school and summer programs focused on mentoring and behavioral, social, and emotional learning interventions and enrichment activities directed toward low-income students of color. This appropriation is onetime and available until spent.
additions: $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Sanneh Foundation, a nonprofit organization, to fund out-of-school and summer programs focused on mentoring and behavioral, social, and emotional learning interventions and enrichment activities directed toward low-income students of color. This appropriation is onetime and available until spent.
